changelog:
v3.7.7 — Channel Switching, HEVC HDR, No-Audio Flash

Three customer-facing fixes plus better debug visibility:

• Channel up/down works again after the player switches to the FFmpeg pipeline for 5.1 surround. The internal player rebuild was dropping every key-handler callback (channel switch, audio button, sleep timer, etc.) — now they all stay wired through any rebuild.

• On devices that can't decode HDR (HEVC 10-bit), the player no longer wastes a hardware decoder slot before showing the "can't play HDR" message. The friendly error appears instantly with no decoder churn.

• The "No Audio Track" badge in the top-right no longer flashes briefly on every channel change. Now it only appears if the channel genuinely has no audio after a short wait.

Under the hood
• New GLUE_CALLBACKS_WIRED + KEY_NO_HANDLER events in the debug log so we can spot "silent" handler-not-wired bugs without needing to reproduce on a debug build.
